comments.content: Returning `None` (instead of an empty list) when there are no matching doc names breaks the caller in `api_app.py:document_rm`. There, the result is used directly with `if doc_id not in doc_ids: doc_ids.append(doc_id)`, which raises `TypeError` on `None`. Return `[]` here instead of `None` (or drop the early return entirely, since the list comprehension already yields `[]`).
